rows.definition: internal/devindex.ScopePlan is the read-only answer to 'what is the smallest thing I can run to validate this sub-section, and what does that NOT prove?'. (*Catalog).PlanScope resolves one scope token - a lane name, a repo-relative path, or a package directory - to the package directories the scope covers, the minimal go build/vet/test commands for exactly those packages, and a does_not_prove list naming what a green run leaves unproven. It is a pure projection over the already-loaded Catalog: no I/O, no clock, no subprocess, and it runs nothing.
rows.distinction: A VALIDATION SCOPE for a sub-section of the monorepo - NOT an execution plan (ctxplan's chosen resident view, memq's explain plan, or a dispatch/issue plan) and NOT a land-verify candidate checkout (verifyTopologyCandidate). It names the commands a human or agent would run and the boundary those commands do not cross; it never runs them. It refuses rather than widens: SCOPE_UNBOUNDED for a scope naming the whole module, and SCOPE_UNDECLARED_LANE for a lane with no declared [lanes.trees] leaf.
